items.label: SUPER CARS+7/AWT
items.why: The packed BASIC program starts at $0810. Its loader and trainer stage launch the resident game at $0400.

items.label: track 35, sector 0
items.why: The eight sectors form two orphan chains, 0–8 and 6–14–4–12–2–10. They contain unrelated BASIC display fragments, including a real-time DYCP demo. The boot selects the named PRG whose chain starts at 14/0. The resident listing has no LOAD or DOS entry calls and its CIA2 port access selects the VIC bank. A LOAD checkpoint stayed at zero in the observed resident menu and race paths.
